messages: Aria L: quick note from today's design review — compact mode + left rail expand causes performance badges in the compare table to shift and VoiceOver doesn't announce pin state. repro on macOS Big Sur + VO. Ben P: saw the same in QA. when the rail opens in compact density the badges jump horizontally, looks janky. Sophie (UX): suggestion: reserve the badge column with an explicit track in the grid so expanding the rail doesn't reflow that cell. also add an aria-live announcement when a version is pinned/unpinned and improve aria-labels on pin controls. Ravi - Eng: doable. plan: change compare grid to explicit columns like `grid-template-columns: 1fr 72px auto;` for the badge column, and add a sr-only status element for announcements. will also ensure we toggle `aria-pressed` on the pin button so AT can infer state. Marta - PM: copy nit — tooltip currently says "Pin"; for clarity make tooltip + aria-label include the version like "Pin version v2.1" so context isn't lost in dense views. designbot: accessibility-scan: prefers-reduced-motion not respected on .rail-transition; color-contrast warning on .filter-toggle (ratio 3.6:1). recommend honoring prefers-reduced-motion and adjusting token or weight. Sophie (UX): also we should ensure keyboard focus isn't removed during the rail expand; move focus into the rail container and preserve a visible focus ring (no disappearing frames). Ravi - Eng: will implement a small JS helper to restore focus after DOM changes and respect `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS media query for transitions. for announcements I'll add `` and write `Version v2.1 pinned` on pin events. Ben P: i'll add an e2e that toggles the rail and asserts that badge bounding boxes don't change more than 1px. i18n-bot: reminder: changing pin tooltip to include version requires new i18n keys with placeholders. please add keys and copy notes for translators. Marta - PM: prioritization for this sprint: 1) reserve badge column / grid stability (high), 2) prefers-reduced-motion + persistent focus (high), 3) aria-live announcements + improved aria-labels (high), 4) copy + i18n updates (medium). Sophie (UX): i'll upload mocks and a before/after GIF to the design doc and include the VoiceOver repro steps. Aria L: great — assigning implementation to Ravi and QA to Ben. thanks all, dropping this into #design-review board. :sparkles:
